scanNote:
YANGI BO'LIM: 'American English - British English Guide' (Amerika-Britaniya inglizchasi qo'llanmasi). Bosilgan bet raqami: 164.

Bet to'rt bo'limga bo'lingan ikki ustunli lug'at (chapda AmE, o'ngda BrE):
• Cars and Driving (mashina va haydash) — 24 juft
• Travelling/Commuting (sayohat/qatnov) — 9 juft
• Food (ovqat) — 18 juft
• Others (boshqalar) — boshlanishi, 18 juft (davomi 165-betda)

⚠ KITOB XATOSI (tinish): 'call, phone → ring up, phone,call' — oxirgi verguldan keyin BO'SH JOY QO'YILMAGAN. Rasmni kattalashtirib tekshirdim.

⚠ Bu bo'lim Culture Clips'dan keyin keladi va alohida ma'lumotnoma (unit 975).

⚠ E'TIBOR: kitob davomida uchragan BrE/AmE farqlari shu jadvalda rasman umumlashtirilgan: chips/French fries (Photo File 8-unit varag'i), crisps/potato chips, biscuit/cookie (159-bet), flat/apartment (Photo File 3-unit varag'i).

exercises.instructionEn: American English - British English Guide: Cars and Driving, Travelling/Commuting, Food, Others.
exercises.instructionUz: Amerika-Britaniya inglizchasi qo'llanmasi: mashina va haydash, sayohat, ovqat, boshqalar.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — YANGI MA'LUMOTNOMA BO'LIMI.

  Kitobning oxirida AmE (Amerika) va BrE
  (Britaniya) inglizchasi farqlari jadval
  qilib berilgan.

  Bu betda TO'RT bo'lim bor:
     • Cars and Driving (24 juft)
     • Travelling/Commuting (9 juft)
     • Food (18 juft)
     • Others — boshlanishi (davomi
       165-betda)


⚠ NEGA IKKI XIL INGLIZChA BOR:

  Ingliz tili Amerikaga 400 yil oldin
  borgan va u yerda O'ZIChA rivojlangan.
  Natijada ba'zi so'zlar ikki mamlakatda
  BOShQAChA.

  ⚠ Bu — ikki TIL emas, BIR tilning ikki
  KO'RINIShI. Amerikaliklar va
  britaniyaliklar bir-birini bemalol
  tushunadi.


⚠ QAYSI BIRINI O'RGANISh KERAK?

  ⚠ Enterprise kitobi BRITANIYA
  inglizchasida yozilgan — shuning uchun
  asosiy so'zlar BrE.

  ⚠ Lekin filmlar va internetda AmE
  ko'proq uchraydi — IKKALASINI ham
  TANISH kerak.

  ⚠ Gapirganda esa bittasiga sodiq
  qoling — aralashtirmaslik yaxshi.


⚠ KITOBDA OLDIN UChRAGAN JUFTLAR:

  Bu jadval kitob davomida aytilgan
  farqlarni rasman umumlashtiradi:

     French fries / chips    (Photo File 8-unit varag'i)
     potato chips / crisps   (Photo File 8-unit varag'i)
     cookie / biscuit        (159-bet)
     apartment / flat        (Photo File 3-unit varag'i)


⚠ KITOB XATOSI (tinish belgisi):

  'Others' bo'limida:
     'call, phone → ring up, phone,call'

  ⚠ Oxirgi VERGULDAN KEYIN BO'Sh JOY
  qo'yilmagan. To'g'risi:
     'ring up, phone, call'


⚠ ENG MUHIM 10 JUFT (bu betdan):

   AmE            BrE
   ─────────────  ─────────────
   gas            petrol
   truck          lorry
   cab            taxi
   subway         underground
   sidewalk       pavement
   apartment      flat
   French fries   chips
   candy          sweets
   cookie         biscuit
   attorney       solicitor


⚠⚠ ENG XAVFLI JUFT — 'SUBWAY':

     AmE 'subway' = METRO
     BrE 'subway' = YER OSTI PIYODA
                    O'TISh JOYI!

  ⚠ Londonda metro 'the Underground'
  yoki 'the Tube' deyiladi.

  ⚠ Londonda 'subway' belgisini ko'rsangiz
  — bu piyoda o'tish joyi, metro EMAS!


⚠⚠ 'BILLION' — TARIXIY FARQ:

  Jadvalda:
     AmE: billion = thousand million
          (milliard, 10⁹)
     BrE: billion = million million
          (10¹²)

  ⚠ DIQQAT: bu ESKI Britaniya tizimi.
  HOZIRGI Britaniyada ham AmE ma'nosi
  qabul qilingan: billion = milliard.

  ⚠ Kitob yozilgan davrda eski farq hali
  eslatib o'tilar edi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR (asosiylari):
  a guide     = qo'llanma
  petrol      = benzin (BrE)
  a lorry     = yuk mashinasi (BrE)
  a motorway  = avtomagistral (BrE)
  a roundabout = aylanma chorraha (BrE)
  the underground = metro (BrE)
  a pavement  = piyodalar yo'lkasi (BrE)
  a solicitor = advokat (BrE)
  a rucksack  = ryukzak (BrE)
  sweets      = shirinliklar (BrE)
  a courgette = kabachok (BrE)
  an aubergine = baqlajon (BrE)

points.en: American English and British English are two varieties of the same language.
points.uz: Amerika va Britaniya inglizchasi — bir tilning ikki ko'rinishi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu — ikki TIL emas. Amerikaliklar va
britaniyaliklar bir-birini bemalol
tushunadi.

⚠ Enterprise kitobi BRITANIYA inglizchasida
yozilgan.

⚠ Maslahat: ikkalasini TANING, lekin
gapirganda bittasiga sodiq qoling.

points.en: AmE 'subway' = BrE 'underground, tube'  —  BUT BrE 'subway' = an underpass!
points.uz: AmE 'subway' = metro; LEKIN BrE da 'subway' — yer osti piyoda o'tish joyi!
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ ENG XAVFLI JUFT!

Londonda 'subway' belgisi PIYODA O'TISH
JOYini bildiradi, metro emas.

London metrosi: 'the Underground' yoki
'the Tube'.

⚠ Jadvalning o'zida ham bor:
AmE 'underpass' = BrE 'subway'.

points.en: AmE 'gas, gasoline' = BrE 'petrol';  AmE 'gas station' = BrE 'petrol station, garage'.
points.noteUz:
⚠ AmE 'gas' — 'gasoline' ning qisqartmasi.

⚠ ADASHTIRMANG: 'gas' BrE da ham bor, lekin
u GAZ (havo holatidagi modda) degani.

⚠ 'a garage' BrE da ta'mirlash ustaxonasi
ham.

points.en: AmE 'French fries' = BrE 'chips';  AmE 'potato chips' = BrE 'crisps'.
points.uz: AmE 'French fries' = BrE 'chips' (kartoshka fri); AmE 'chips' = BrE 'crisps' (chipsi).
points.noteUz:
⚠ Photo File 8-unit varag'ida ko'rgan juftimiz — endi jadvalda
rasman.

AYLANMA:
  AmE fries  = BrE chips
  AmE chips  = BrE crisps

⚠ 'fish and chips' — britancha taom nomi,
shuning uchun 'chips'.

points.en: AmE 'billion = thousand million'; BrE 'billion = million million'.
points.uz: AmE 'billion' = ming million (milliard); eski BrE 'billion' = million million.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ TARIXIY FARQ.

HOZIRGI Britaniyada ham AmE ma'nosi qabul
qilingan: billion = MILLIARD (10⁹).

⚠ Kitob yozilgan davrda eski farq hali
eslatib o'tilar edi. Bugun 'billion' hamma
joyda milliard.

points.en: call, phone  =  ring up, phone, call
points.noteUz:
⚠ KITOB XATOSI: kitobda 'ring up,
phone,call' — oxirgi verguldan keyin BO'SH
JOY qo'yilmagan.

⚠ 'to ring up' = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq (BrE):
'I'll ring you up tomorrow.'

⚠ 'ring' TARTIBSIZ: ring - rang - rung.

exercises.instructionEn: Cars and Driving: match the American English word to its British English equivalent.
exercises.instructionUz: Mashina va haydash: Amerika inglizchasidagi so'zni Britaniya muqobili bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
'CARS AND DRIVING' BO'LIMI — 24 JUFT.

  Quyida eng muhim juftlar mashq qilinadi.
  To'liq ro'yxat tepadagi tushuntirishda.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT (AmE → BrE):

  antenna        → aerial
  circle, rotary → roundabout
  defroster      → window heater
  detour         → diversion
  divided highway → dual carriageway
  fender         → wing
  flat (tire)    → flat tyre, puncture
  gas, gasoline  → petrol
  gas station    → petrol station, garage
  gear shift     → gear lever, stick
  high beams     → full lights
  hood           → bonnet
  intersection   → crossroads
  interstate, highway, freeway → motorway
  low beams      → lights dipped
  minibus        → van/minibus
  motorcycle     → motorbike, motorcycle
  overpass       → flyover
  parking lot    → car park
  pass (vehicle) → overtake, pass
  pedestrian crossing → zebra crossing,
                   pedestrian crossing
  rental car     → hire car
  transmission   → gear box
  truck          → lorry, van
  turn signals   → indicators
  windshield     → windscreen


⚠ QIZIQ JUFTLAR:

  'hood' / 'bonnet' — ikkalasi ham
  KIYIM nomi (kapyushon / ayollar
  qalpoqchasi). Mashina kapoti ustki
  qopqoq bo'lgani uchun shunday atalgan.

  'zebra crossing' — oq-qora chiziqlari
  ZEBRA terisiga o'xshagani uchun.

  'tire' (AmE) / 'tyre' (BrE) — bir so'z,
  IKKI XIL IMLO.


⚠ IMLO FARQI HAM BOR:

     AmE tire  = BrE tyre
     (g'ildirak shinasi)

  ⚠ 156-betdagi 'color/colour' kabi —
  ba'zi so'zlar faqat IMLOda farq qiladi.

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ AmE 'gas' — 'gasoline' qisqartmasi.

⚠ BrE da 'gas' — havo holatidagi GAZ.
Benzin esa 'petrol'.

'gas station' = 'petrol station'.

⚠ 'a lorry' — faqat Britaniyada ishlatiladi.

⚠ 'a van' — kichikroq yuk mashinasi
(ikkala mamlakatda ham tushunarli).

⚠ QIZIQ: ikkala so'z ham KIYIM nomi!
'a hood' = kapyushon;
'a bonnet' = ayollar qalpoqchasi.

Mashinaning ustki qopqog'i bo'lgani uchun
shunday atalgan.

⚠ Farq faqat ikkinchi qismda:
AmE 'SHIELD' (qalqon) /
BrE 'SCREEN' (ekran, to'siq).

'wind' (shamol) qismi bir xil.

⚠ 'a lot' AmE da 'yer uchastkasi' degani.

⚠ BrE 'car park' — so'zma-so'z 'mashina
bog'i'.

⚠ 'crossroads' — '-s' bilan tugasa ham
BIRLIK bo'lishi mumkin:
'There IS a crossroads ahead.'

⚠ 'a zebra crossing' esa piyodalar o'tish
joyi — oq-qora chiziqlari zebraga o'xshaydi.

⚠ 'to indicate' = ko'rsatmoq — chiroq
qayoqqa burilishni KO'RSATADI.

⚠ AmE nomi to'g'ridan: 'burilish
signallari'.

⚠ AmE da UCHTA so'z bor: 'interstate'
(shtatlararo), 'highway', 'freeway'.

⚠ BrE da bitta: 'motorway' (M1, M25 kabi
nomlanadi).

exercises.instructionEn: Travelling and Food: match the American English word to its British English equivalent.
exercises.instructionUz: Sayohat va ovqat: Amerika inglizchasidagi so'zni Britaniya muqobili bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
'TRAVELLING/COMMUTING' — 9 JUFT:

  airplane        → aeroplane
  baggage claim   → baggage reclaim
  bus             → coach
  cab             → taxi
  one-way (ticket) → single
  railroad        → railway
  round trip (ticket) → return (ticket)
  sidewalk        → pavement
  subway          → underground, tube
  underpass       → subway


'FOOD' — 18 JUFT:

  appetizers      → starters
  baked potato    → jacket potato
  broil           → grill
  candy           → sweets
  candy store     → confectioner,
                    sweet shop
  canned          → tinned
  cookie          → biscuit
  corn            → sweetcorn, maize
  cotton candy    → candy floss
  dessert         → pudding, sweet,
                    dessert
  eggplant        → aubergine
  fish sticks     → fish fingers
  French fries    → chips
  ground meat     → mince
  jello           → jelly
  jelly           → jam
  oatmeal         → porridge
  potato chips    → crisps
  preserves       → conserves
  without or with (milk/cream in coffee)
                  → black or white
  zucchini        → courgettes


⚠⚠ 'JELLY' — AYLANMA TUZOQ:

     AmE jello  = BrE jelly   (jele)
     AmE jelly  = BrE jam     (murabbo)

  ⚠ Amerikada 'jelly' — MURABBO,
  Britaniyada esa — JELE!

  ⚠ 'chips' bilan bir xil aylanma holat.


⚠ 'JACKET POTATO' — QIZIQ NOM:

  BrE 'jacket potato' = po'sti bilan
  pishirilgan kartoshka.

  ⚠ 'a jacket' = kurtka — kartoshkaning
  PO'STI uning 'kurtkasi'!


⚠ 'BLACK OR WHITE' — QAHVA:

  Britaniyada qahva so'ralganda:
     'black' = sutsiz
     'white' = sut bilan

  ⚠ Amerikada esa: 'with or without
  milk/cream' deb so'raladi.


⚠ SABZAVOT NOMLARI — FRANSUZ IZI:

     BrE aubergine  (fransuzchadan)
     AmE eggplant   ('tuxum o'simligi' —
        oq navlari tuxumga o'xshagan)

     BrE courgette  (fransuzchadan)
     AmE zucchini   (italyanchadan)

  ⚠ Britaniya — Fransiyaga yaqin,
  Amerikada esa italyan muhojirlari
  ko'p bo'lgan. So'zlar shundan.

pairs.whyUz:
⚠⚠ ENG XAVFLI JUFT!

BrE da 'subway' = YER OSTI PIYODA O'TISH
JOYI (jadvalda: AmE 'underpass' = BrE
'subway').

London metrosi: 'the Underground' / 'the
Tube' (tunnellari quvurga o'xshagani uchun).

⚠ AmE 'sidewalk' = 'yon tomonda yurish
joyi' — to'g'ridan tushunarli.

⚠ BrE 'pavement' — 'to pave' (tosh yotqizmoq)
dan.

⚠ Kassada so'rash:
BrE: 'A return to London, please.'
AmE: 'A round trip to Boston, please.'

⚠ Bir tomonlama: BrE 'single' / AmE
'one-way'.

⚠ AmE 'candy' — SANALMAYDI:
'some candy'.

⚠ BrE 'sweets' — KO'PLIKDA: 'a sweet' =
bitta konfet.

⚠ 'candy store' = 'sweet shop'.

⚠ 159-betda ko'rgan juftimiz.

⚠ AmE da 'biscuit' ham bor, lekin u —
yumshoq TUZLI bulochka!

⚠ 'a cookie' — golland tilidan ('koekje' =
kichik kulcha).

⚠⚠ AYLANMA TUZOQ:
  AmE jello = BrE jelly (JELE)
  AmE jelly = BrE jam   (MURABBO)

Amerikada 'jelly' murabbo, Britaniyada jele!

⚠ Photo File 8-unit varag'idagi nonushta matnida 'toast with
JAM' — britancha.

⚠ 'porridge' — an'anaviy Britaniya (ayniqsa
Shotlandiya) nonushtasi.

⚠ 'oats' = suli; 'oatmeal' = suli uni.

⚠ AmE 'eggplant' = 'tuxum o'simligi' —
baqlajonning OQ navlari tuxumga o'xshaydi.

⚠ BrE 'aubergine' — fransuz tilidan.

⚠ Shu kabi: BrE 'courgette' (fransuzcha) =
AmE 'zucchini' (italyancha) = kabachok.

groups.explanationUz: AmE va BrE qanday farq qiladi.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠⚠ BIR SO'Z — IKKI MAMLAKATDA IKKI MA'NO
groups.explanationUz: Eng ehtiyot bo'lish kerak bo'lgan so'zlar.

patterns.formula: In British English, [AmE so'z] is called [BrE so'z].
patterns.exampleEn: In British English, an elevator is called a lift.
patterns.explanationUz:
Farqlarni tushuntirish qolipi.
⚠ 'is called' — majhul nisbat.

patterns.formula: Americans say [A], while the British say [B].
patterns.exampleEn: Americans say 'truck', while the British say 'lorry'.

patterns.formula: A single to [joy], please.  /  A return to [joy], please.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Britaniya kassasida chipta so'rash.
AmE: 'A round trip to Boston, please.'
